about: What the character controller must get right, a row a criterion (tools/controller/README.md, docs/controller.md's production criteria): what a player notices, its bar and source, the check that measures it, cheap (the plain-Rust course, seconds) or heavy (the in-game film, a bench), whether it is measurable yet. `noticed` is how much a player notices it, 5 most; the scorecard orders failing rows by it (the task list). `course` names the test that drives the mover through terra_motion::course and prints its numbers.

criteria.notice: a body driven fast at a wall one voxel thick ends up in it or through it
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 1; Jolt (swept move); ours for the SDF sweep

criteria.notice: a body driven fast at another passes through it
a body driven fast at a door passes through it
criteria.needs: a base's doors answered by the mover's query trait in the plain course (D53's buildings source, stage 2)

criteria.notice: a body's capsule sinks into the ground, a wall or a roof
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 2; Jolt (tolerance 1 mm, padding 2 cm)

criteria.notice: a body's capsule sits a little into what it touches
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 2; Jolt (tolerance 1 mm, padding 2 cm)

criteria.notice: a slope too steep is walked up, or one shallow enough stops the body
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 3; Jolt's limit; our data (50 deg for a man)

criteria.notice: a body goes up a hill as fast as on the flat
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 4; player.md, slopes slow you

criteria.notice: a step the body should walk up stops it, or one too high is walked up
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 5; Jolt WalkStairs; our one rule (0.55 m for a man)

criteria.notice: a base's step is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.needs: a base's cubes answered by the mover's query trait in the plain course (stage 2)

criteria.notice: a prop's top is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.needs: props' boxes answered by the mover's query trait in the plain course (stage 2)

criteria.notice: a rock or log is climbed by a different rule than the ground's
criteria.needs: trees' and rocks' pieces (terra_core::solid) answered by the mover's query trait in the plain course (stage 2)

criteria.notice: a step pops the body up in one frame
criteria.needs: the in-game filmed course (stage 1b): the shown root's rise a frame over each step, and its settling within 0.15 s

criteria.notice: sprinting down a 45 deg slope the body leaves the ground and floats
sprinting down a stair of 0.3 m steps the body hops off each one
a jump in a 2 m tunnel puts the head into the roof
a jump into a roof keeps rising instead of stopping
a body falling on a round world lands off the line to its centre
a body on a round world stands tilted from the line to its centre
a jump goes higher or lower than its launch speed and gravity say
a jump pressed just after running off a ledge is lost
criteria.unit: s off the kind's coyote time
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 10; the platformer convention; our data (0.1 s)

criteria.notice: a jump pressed just before landing is lost
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 10; the platformer convention; our data (0.15 s)

criteria.notice: a body that has touched down is not grounded yet
a body bounces on landing
a landing's speed is not reported, or is not the fall's, so a fall cannot hurt
criteria.unit: every drop's within a tick of gravity of sqrt(2gh)

criteria.notice: the body starts moving a tick or more after the key is pressed
every kind gets up to speed alike, whatever its file says
criteria.unit: ticks off the kind's data (to top speed, and back to standing)

criteria.notice: every kind turns alike, whatever its file says
two kinds whose files differ move alike
criteria.unit: results alike of those the two kinds' data set apart

criteria.notice: steering in the air is stronger or weaker than the kind's data
bodies stand inside each other in a crowd
a man shoves a body four times his weight as far as it shoves him
a body that holds its place is shoved
a body squeezes through a gap narrower than itself, or is stopped by one wide enough
deep water is a wall the body cannot walk into
a body in deep water sinks or does not float up to the surface
criteria.needs: swimming in the mover (ground state swimming, buoyancy as data) and open question 3

criteria.notice: a swimmer cannot dive or rise on intent
criteria.needs: swimming in the mover and open question 3 (how to dive)

criteria.notice: breath runs out above water, or never under it
criteria.needs: breath in the mover's report and open question 3 (how long)

criteria.notice: sprinting, jumping or swimming costs more or less than the kind's data
criteria.needs: stamina carried through the course's mover trait, with the kind's costs as data (stage 2)

criteria.notice: two machines see a crowd end in different places
criteria.source: docs/controller.md criterion 19; D51, D138; reruns: again, bodies given reversed, interleaved

criteria.notice: many bodies moving slow the server's tick
criteria.needs: a release CPU bench of the mover (one body walking the course on one core; 1,000 under 4 ms a tick on the server's cores): cargo xtask bench measures the game's frames on the GPU, so stage 2 adds the mover's own bench

criteria.notice: feet slide over the ground at walk, jog or sprint, or in starts, stops and turns
criteria.needs: the in-game filmed course (stage 1b): each foot contact's slide, as the duel film's film.feet_sliding reads it

criteria.notice: what passes on the plain course fails in the game, on dug ground and a base
criteria.needs: the in-game filmed course (stage 1b): the plain course's features dug and built in the yard, walked, jogged and sprinted by a scripted player (--press, cargo xtask gpu film)
